title: Extract the scanner from the CLI
description:
Purpose: The scanner is a library. The CLI is how people run it and upload a diagram. Split them so programmatic scan, regression tests, behavior specs, and the evaluation framework live in one project.

New repo: DataParade-io/scanner
Package: @dataparade/scanner
Public API: createDefaultScanConfiguration, scan(config) -> ScanResult.

Not the DataParade-io/dataparade monorepo. A new org repo.

First-cut moves:
- ingest, analyzers, patterns/ YAML, classifier, data-flow, pii-signals
- core structural pipeline, graph mapping, schema, types
- detection config that the engine needs (actor / property / third-party)
- unit tests for those
- tests/eval, tests/benchmark
- features/scan-findings.feature and scanner-recall-evaluation.feature

Stays in the CLI:
- commander, env, write dataflow.json, upload, quota, telemetry, Sentry
- AI enrichment and LangSmith tracing (wrap after scan(), not inside it)

Hard cut: scan-pipeline.ts today imports AI and tracing. Split deterministic scan from the AI wrap before the move, or the library drags the CLI with it.

Exclusions: do not merge to main; do not accept gold; do not use --local.

Definition of done: scanner repo exists, CLI depends on @dataparade/scanner, in-tree engine copy is gone, eval and corpus run from scanner.

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: Restructure plan 2026-08-28: repo is DataParade-io/scanner (not dataparade-scanner, not the dataparade monorepo). Split scan-pipeline so scan() has no AI/tracing import before the file move. Detection config moves with the engine. Gherkin scan-findings and scanner-recall move with eval.
